gloss: unlucky day (except around noon); inauspicious day in the rokuyo calendar

definitions.gloss: unlucky day (except around noon); inauspicious day in the rokuyo calendar
definitions.explanation: One of the six days in the traditional rokuyo calendar cycle, considered generally unlucky except for the period around noon. Associated with fire-related misfortune.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{赤口|しゃっこう}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{気|き}をつけよう→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Today is shakkou, so let's be careful.

examples.japanese: {赤口|しゃっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避|さ}けた→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: It's better to avoid holding a wedding on a shakkou day.

examples.japanese: ⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{赤口|しゃっこう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{正午|しょうご}→正午：03231_shougo⟧ごろ⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{吉|きち}→吉：19344_kichi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦お{昼|ひる}→お昼：02532_ohiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませた→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: The calendar said shakkou, but since around noon is considered auspicious, we completed the contract at midday.

notes:
One of the six days in the ⟦{六曜|ろくよう}→六曜：29161_rokuyou⟧ (rokuyo) calendar system, which cycles through {先勝|せんしょう}, ⟦{友引|ともびき}→友引：24469_tomobiki⟧, {先負|せんぶ}, ⟦{仏滅|ぶつめつ}→仏滅：16754_butsumetsu⟧, ⟦{大安|たいあん}→大安：16753_taian⟧, and {赤口|しゃっこう}. The rokuyo system is still printed on many Japanese calendars and influences the scheduling of weddings, funerals, and other important events.

{赤口|しゃっこう} is considered the second most unlucky day after ⟦{仏滅|ぶつめつ}→仏滅：16754_butsumetsu⟧. The only auspicious time is around noon (roughly 11 a.m. to 1 p.m.). The character {赤|しゃく} is associated with fire, so fire-related accidents are especially feared on this day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {赤口|しゃっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: a shakkou day
- {赤口|しゃっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid shakkou days
- {赤口|しゃっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正午|しょうご}→正午：03231_shougo⟧: noon on shakkou (the only auspicious time)
